answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tundra weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The summit report reveals the merge explicitly at each quill. Because of that, an attacker who spins up 235 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 51 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3476 identities would post 4961 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
